note: RxNorm signature of a raw market key: the set of RxNorm base ingredient (IN) concepts its FDA structured substance names resolve to, salts followed from the precise ingredient to its base. Precision is the share of this paper's merge groups whose member keys all share one signature, among groups where at least two members have one. Recall is the share of same-signature key pairs inside one route-and-form bucket, and of equal stated strength, that the rule merges; an RxNorm ingredient set carries no strength, so same-signature pairs whose ingredient strings differ numerically are excluded and counted, not scored against the rule. Keys without a complete signature are reported separately and scored neither way. RxNorm adjudicates ingredient identity, not clinical substitutability, so agreement here is evidence about the normalisation step alone.
